gap.note: DS-1 r2 + PG-1 1: 64+-4 at >=1024, 48+-4 below, measured from the sub-nav bottom (hero bottom if none) to the first content element. The first section has no padding-top and no border-top. #76 FQ7 (64/40) is retired.

grid.note: Shared DocumentLayout (components/ui, b2cff780): 7fr/5fr from 1024, gap clamp(40px,6vw,80px). The INDEX aside is first in the DOM; below 1024 it is the D7 sticky scroller above the body; a CONTENT aside follows main.

heading.note: NOS Design (a), FINAL: h3 = --fs-lg 25px Fraunces 400 at every width; h2 below 768 = the v4 .h2 clamp floor, 32px at 390, weight 300; line-height h2 1.15, h3 1.25. .doc-h2 (0,2,0) beats .nos-theme h2. The only h4 in the standard is PYV-1's (Karla 16/600 ink, 24px above, 8px below).

hero.minHeightClamp: PG-1 4: >=768 .nos-hero-inner min-height clamp(320px,22vw,380px), align-content start, padding-block clamp(48px,4vw,72px); <768 the 2:1 photo band stays and the copy follows at padding-block 32px

photoBox.below1024: the stacked photo is full width under the copy, no scrim

hero.scrim: the v4 .ihero 90deg gradient (0.92 -> 0.06) remapped across the photo box

sharpness.ruling: NOS Design (c), final: photo box 38%-100% at >=1024; need at 2056@2 about 2550, width-driven; assert BOTH width-driven and height-driven needs; stacked below 1024 full width (390@3 needs 1170)
sharpness.formula: required = ceil(max(boxW, boxH x srcW/srcH) x DPR) from the measured img box; served = naturalWidth of currentSrc in a bare Image(); required > the crop's native width fails as CLAMPED

hero.interimReuse: Pool (NOS Design, crops-c verdict): D1, PK1 (= PK2), PK3, Y1 plus #76 crops with width >= 2550 (S1b, S2c, S3a, S3b, S2a, H4a; H4b is 2200 and fails need). V1, V3 and P1 FAIL and are retired. No repeat within a nav group; cross-group reuse logged. #76 crops stay live until the PR that ships .ihero; the (c) crops land in that PR.

heightCap.note: PG-1 4 is OWNED by this spec (not #76). Gates: with an h1 and a one-line lede the hero is <=380 at 2056 and <=330 at 1440; first h2 or index card above the fold at 1440x900. The same numbers now live in #76, whose checks are relocked; these pass once the dev has #76 merged.

facts.firstScreenCount: every fact box fully inside the first viewport at 1440x900 and 390x844@3
facts.type: HeroFact {term, value}, no TBC field; a fact with an empty term or value is dropped and fewer than 2 renders no row (normaliseHeroFacts, lib/hero-facts.ts)

focus.rule: no outline, box-shadow or border painted on a programmatically focused h1 after client navigation; focus management itself kept (document.activeElement is the h1)

faq.categoryCountRule: equals the number of category headings in the Drive FAQ doc (13 in the 24 Oct version per the lead; 12 in lib/data/faq-sections.ts today)

bans: a row of equal cards as page structure
p whose sole child is strong
any element other than the eyebrow with border-radius >= 999 (chips, pills, bubbles) on any route
the 'To be confirmed by the show committee' legend chip
a split section with an h2 alone in a column
an h2 naming a sibling route

index.d7: Below 1024 the index is a sticky horizontal scroller: top env(safe-area-inset-top,0) under 700 (header not sticky), the sticky header's height from 700; 32px trailing mask fade only while scrollWidth > clientWidth; scroll-snap; active item scrolled into view; never overlaps the header; reachable mid-page at 390
index.rows: 13-or-n names verbatim, Karla 15px, >=44px, hairline --rule-soft, disjoint boxes
index.active: royal text with a green-1 underline; no pill, fill or side border
index.landing: clicking a link lands its h2 below the sticky header(s) (scroll-margin-top)

tbc: A TBC disclosure = --gold fill + a 1px --rule-soft hairline + its text. No dashed 2px rail (R11 retired). No legend chip.

ws1.ticketEdge: .nk-ticket notches, .nk-perf and .nk-stamp stay but only inside [data-ticket-card] (purchasable ticket cards: /tickets, /workshops, /conferences ticket products); never on content, event or info cards
ws1.statusCard: the TBC pill chip inside the status card goes; the card's sentences stay verbatim
ws1.programmeH2: /workshops h2 'Programme' has no Drive source (checked content/drive-source and goldens/sources): builder copy, flagged for Lee-Ann's doc, not rewritten

testBar.rule: absent on every route in the table; present ONLY on /tickets/* and the payment step (paths from SAOC's branch fix/testbar-ticket-pages-only, to be taken once it merges). Brad: 'The warning is only for the selling of tickets.' /conferences is NOT a tickets page. The dev does not change lib/ticketing-test-mode.ts.
